title: House Robber II
statement: Same as House Robber, except the houses are arranged in a CIRCLE, so the first and last are adjacent and cannot both be robbed. Return the maximum you can take.
hints: The circle only adds one constraint: house 0 and house n-1 cannot both be chosen.
So either you skip the last house, or you skip the first. Every valid plan falls into one of those two cases.
Run the plain House Robber solver twice, on nums[0..n-2] and on nums[1..n-1], and take the larger. Handle the single-house array separately.
